title.en: Call a lead and log how it went
title.hi: Lead ko call karo, result log karo
title.mr: Lead la call kara, result log kara

description.en: Call your leads straight from Sales X-Ray and log how each call went in two taps: who to call today, the lead's page, calling, logging the result and what happens next, and Start calling for long lists.
description.hi: Sales X-Ray se seedha apne leads ko call kijiye aur har call ka result do tap mein log kijiye: aaj kisko call karna hai, lead ka page, call, result aur aage kya hoga, aur lambi list ke liye Start calling.
description.mr: Sales X-Ray madhun thet tumchya leads na call kara aani pratyek call cha result don tap madhye log kara: aaj konala call karaycha, lead cha page, call, result aani pudhe kay honar, aani mothya list saathi Start calling.

names.Can I show you in 10 minutes how: Can I quickly show you how

say.en: In this video, you'll call a lead from Sales X-Ray, and log how the call went, in just two taps.
say.hi: इस video में हम Sales X-Ray से lead को call करेंगे, और call कैसा रहा, वो बस दो tap में log करेंगे.
say.mr: या video मध्ये आपण Sales X-Ray मधून lead ला call करू, आणि call कसा झाला, ते फक्त दोन tap मध्ये log करू.

latn.hi: Is video mein hum Sales X-Ray se lead ko call karenge, aur call kaisa raha, woh bas do tap mein log karenge.
latn.mr: Ya video madhye aapan Sales X-Ray madhun lead la call karu, aani call kasa jhala, te fakta don tap madhye log karu.

say.en: Next, see how to read the Report Sales X-Ray makes from your calls.
say.hi: अगले video में देखेंगे, आपके calls से बनी Report कैसे पढ़ें.
say.mr: पुढच्या video मध्ये बघूया, तुमच्या calls मधून बनलेली Report कशी वाचायची.

latn.hi: Agle video mein dekhenge, aapke calls se bani Report kaise padhein.
latn.mr: Pudhchya video madhye baghuya, tumchya calls madhun banleli Report kashi vaachaychi.

say.en: Log every call in two taps. Here's how.
say.hi: हर call दो tap में log कीजिए. देखिए कैसे.
say.mr: प्रत्येक call दोन tap मध्ये log करा. बघा कसं.

latn.hi: Har call do tap mein log kijiye. Dekhiye kaise.
latn.mr: Pratyek call don tap madhye log kara. Bagha kasa.

say.en: Everything starts in Leads. The To call tab is your list for today.
say.hi: सब कुछ Leads से शुरू होता है. To call tab में आज की पूरी list है.
say.mr: सगळं Leads पासून सुरू होतं. To call tab मध्ये आजची पूर्ण list आहे.

latn.hi: Sab kuch Leads se shuru hota hai. To call tab mein aaj ki poori list hai.
latn.mr: Sagla Leads pasun suru hota. To call tab madhye aajchi poorna list aahe.

say.en: Late follow-ups sit on top. Below them, the people to call right now.
say.hi: जो follow-ups late हो गए, वो सबसे ऊपर. उनके नीचे, जिनको अभी call करना है.
say.mr: जे follow-ups late झालेत, ते सगळ्यात वर. त्यांच्या खाली, ज्यांना आत्ता call करायचाय.

latn.hi: Jo follow-ups late ho gaye, woh sabse upar. Unke neeche, jinko abhi call karna hai.
latn.mr: Je follow-ups late jhalet, te saglyat var. Tyanchya khali, jyanna aatta call karaychay.

say.en: Swipe the tabs to see every stage, like Call back, or Site visit booked.
say.hi: Tabs को swipe कीजिए, हर stage दिखेगा, जैसे Call back, या Site visit booked.
say.mr: Tabs swipe करा, प्रत्येक stage दिसेल, जसं Call back, किंवा Site visit booked.

latn.hi: Tabs ko swipe kijiye, har stage dikhega, jaise Call back, ya Site visit booked.
latn.mr: Tabs swipe kara, pratyek stage disel, jasa Call back, kinva Site visit booked.

say.en: Here's a shortcut: swipe a lead right to call, or left to WhatsApp.
say.hi: एक shortcut: lead को right swipe करो तो call, left swipe करो तो WhatsApp.
say.mr: एक shortcut: lead ला right swipe केलं की call, left swipe केलं की WhatsApp.

latn.hi: Ek shortcut: lead ko right swipe karo toh call, left swipe karo toh WhatsApp.
latn.mr: Ek shortcut: lead la right swipe kela ki call, left swipe kela ki WhatsApp.

say.en: Tap a lead to open it.
say.hi: किसी भी lead पे tap कीजिए.
say.mr: कुठल्याही lead वर tap करा.

latn.hi: Kisi bhi lead pe tap kijiye.
latn.mr: Kuthlyahi lead var tap kara.

say.en: The story so far tells you where things stand, before you even dial.
say.hi: The story so far में पूरा हाल दिखता है, call लगाने से पहले ही.
say.mr: The story so far मध्ये सगळी माहिती दिसते, call लावायच्या आधीच.

latn.hi: The story so far mein poora haal dikhta hai, call lagane se pehle hi.
latn.mr: The story so far madhye sagli maahiti diste, call laavaychya aadhich.

say.en: You also see their stage, and where the lead came from.
say.hi: Lead का stage और वो कहाँ से आया, ये भी यहीं दिखता है.
say.mr: Lead चा stage आणि तो कुठून आला, हे पण इथेच दिसतं.

latn.hi: Lead ka stage aur woh kahan se aaya, yeh bhi yahin dikhta hai.
latn.mr: Lead cha stage aani to kuthun aala, he pan ithech dista.

say.en: Ready? Tap Call, and your phone dials the number straight away.
say.hi: Ready? Call दबाइए, phone तुरंत number लगा देगा.
say.mr: Ready? Call दाबा, phone लगेच number लावेल.

latn.hi: Ready? Call dabaiye, phone turant number laga dega.
latn.mr: Ready? Call daba, phone lagech number laavel.

say.en: Tap Call. Your phone dials right away.
say.hi: Call दबाइए, phone तुरंत लग जाएगा.
say.mr: Call दाबा, phone लगेच लागेल.

latn.hi: Call dabaiye, phone turant lag jaayega.
latn.mr: Call daba, phone lagech laagel.

say.en: Want to send a message instead? WhatsApp and SMS are right next to it.
say.hi: Message भेजना है? WhatsApp और SMS बगल में ही हैं.
say.mr: Message पाठवायचाय? WhatsApp आणि SMS बाजूलाच आहेत.

latn.hi: Message bhejna hai? WhatsApp aur SMS bagal mein hi hain.
latn.mr: Message pathvaychay? WhatsApp aani SMS bajulach aahet.

say.en: When the call ends, Sales X-Ray asks how it went. Or tap Log a call, any time.
say.hi: Call खत्म होते ही Sales X-Ray पूछता है कि call कैसा रहा. या कभी भी Log a call दबाइए.
say.mr: Call संपला की Sales X-Ray विचारतो, call कसा झाला. किंवा कधीही Log a call दाबा.

latn.hi: Call khatam hote hi Sales X-Ray poochta hai ki call kaisa raha. Ya kabhi bhi Log a call dabaiye.
latn.mr: Call sampla ki Sales X-Ray vichaarto, call kasa jhala. Kinva kadhihi Log a call daba.

say.en: Call over? Tap Log a call.
say.hi: Call हो गया? Log a call दबाइए.
say.mr: Call झाला? Log a call दाबा.

latn.hi: Call ho gaya? Log a call dabaiye.
latn.mr: Call jhala? Log a call daba.

say.en: Pick what happened. Here, we talked to them.
say.hi: जो हुआ वो चुनिए. यहाँ बात हो गई, तो We talked.
say.mr: जे झालं ते निवडा. इथे बोलणं झालं, म्हणून We talked.

latn.hi: Jo hua woh chuniye. Yahan baat ho gayi, toh We talked.
latn.mr: Je jhala te nivda. Ithe bolna jhala, mhanun We talked.

say.en: Tap what happened.
say.hi: जो हुआ वो tap कीजिए.
say.mr: जे झालं ते tap करा.

latn.hi: Jo hua woh tap kijiye.
latn.mr: Je jhala te tap kara.

say.en: If they didn't pick up, tap No answer, or Didn't get through.
say.hi: Phone नहीं उठाया? तो No answer, या Didn't get through.
say.mr: Phone उचलला नाही? तर No answer, किंवा Didn't get through.

latn.hi: Phone nahi uthaya? Toh No answer, ya Didn't get through.
latn.mr: Phone uchalla nahi? Tar No answer, kinva Didn't get through.

say.en: Then choose what happens next. Say they agreed to visit: Site visit booked.
say.hi: फिर चुनिए आगे क्या होगा. मान लो वो visit के लिए ready हैं: Site visit booked.
say.mr: मग निवडा पुढे काय होणार. समजा ते visit ला तयार आहेत: Site visit booked.

latn.hi: Phir chuniye aage kya hoga. Maan lo woh visit ke liye ready hain: Site visit booked.
latn.mr: Mag nivda pudhe kay honar. Samja te visit la tayar aahet: Site visit booked.

say.en: Then, what happens next.
say.hi: फिर, आगे क्या होगा.
say.mr: मग, पुढे काय होणार.

latn.hi: Phir, aage kya hoga.
latn.mr: Mag, pudhe kay honar.

say.en: Asked you to call later? Call back. Booked means they bought. Not interested means they won't.
say.hi: बाद में call करने को बोला? Call back. Booked मतलब उन्होंने ले लिया. Not interested मतलब नहीं लेंगे.
say.mr: नंतर call करायला सांगितलं? Call back. Booked म्हणजे त्यांनी घेतलं. Not interested म्हणजे नाही घेणार.

latn.hi: Baad mein call karne ko bola? Call back. Booked matlab unhone le liya. Not interested matlab nahi lenge.
latn.mr: Nantar call karayla sangitla? Call back. Booked mhanje tyanni ghetla. Not interested mhanje nahi ghenaar.

target.placeholder: What they need, what you promised

actions.text: Wants a 2 BHK near Baner. Visit on Sunday morning.

say.en: Add a quick note: what they need, and what you promised.
say.hi: एक छोटा सा note लिख दीजिए: उन्हें क्या चाहिए, और आपने क्या promise किया.
say.mr: एक छोटी note लिहा: त्यांना काय हवंय, आणि तुम्ही काय promise केलं.

latn.hi: Ek chhota sa note likh dijiye: unhe kya chahiye, aur aapne kya promise kiya.
latn.mr: Ek chhoti note liha: tyanna kay havay, aani tumhi kay promise kela.

say.en: Add a quick note.
say.hi: एक छोटा note.
say.mr: एक छोटी note.

latn.hi: Ek chhota note.
latn.mr: Ek chhoti note.

say.en: Tap Save, and it's all there for your next call.
say.hi: Save दबाइए, अगले call के लिए सब याद रहेगा.
say.mr: Save दाबा, पुढच्या call साठी सगळं लक्षात राहील.

latn.hi: Save dabaiye, agle call ke liye sab yaad rahega.
latn.mr: Save daba, pudhchya call saathi sagla lakshat raahil.

say.en: Save. Done.
say.hi: Save. हो गया.
say.mr: Save. झालं.

latn.hi: Save. Ho gaya.
latn.mr: Save. Jhala.

say.en: Every lead moves to the right stage. Site visit booked shows everyone with a visit booked.
say.hi: हर lead सही stage में चला जाता है. Site visit booked में वो सब हैं जिनकी visit book हो चुकी है.
say.mr: प्रत्येक lead योग्य stage मध्ये जातो. Site visit booked मध्ये ते सगळे आहेत ज्यांची visit book झालीय.

latn.hi: Har lead sahi stage mein chala jaata hai. Site visit booked mein woh sab hain jinki visit book ho chuki hai.
latn.mr: Pratyek lead yogya stage madhye jaato. Site visit booked madhye te sagle aahet jyanchi visit book jhaliy.

say.en: Got a long list to get through? Tap Start calling.
say.hi: लंबी list है? Start calling दबाइए.
say.mr: मोठी list आहे? Start calling दाबा.

latn.hi: Lambi list hai? Start calling dabaiye.
latn.mr: Mothi list aahe? Start calling daba.

say.en: Long list? Start calling.
say.hi: लंबी list? Start calling.
say.mr: मोठी list? Start calling.

latn.hi: Lambi list? Start calling.
latn.mr: Mothi list? Start calling.

say.en: Sales X-Ray brings up the next lead, with the best time to reach them.
say.hi: Sales X-Ray अगला lead सामने लाता है, और उन्हें call करने का best time भी.
say.mr: Sales X-Ray पुढचा lead समोर आणतो, आणि त्यांना call करायची best वेळ पण.

latn.hi: Sales X-Ray agla lead saamne laata hai, aur unhe call karne ka best time bhi.
latn.mr: Sales X-Ray pudhcha lead samor aanto, aani tyanna call karaychi best vel pan.

say.en: Your opener is right there, with answers ready for whatever they say.
say.hi: आपका opener यहीं है, और वो जो भी बोलें, उसके जवाब भी ready हैं.
say.mr: तुमचा opener इथेच आहे, आणि ते जे काही बोलतील, त्याची उत्तरं पण ready आहेत.

latn.hi: Aapka opener yahin hai, aur woh jo bhi bolein, uske jawaab bhi ready hain.
latn.mr: Tumcha opener ithech aahe, aani te je kahi boltil, tyachi uttara pan ready aahet.

say.en: Call, log, next. That's the whole routine.
say.hi: Call, log, next. बस, इतना ही.
say.mr: Call, log, next. बस, एवढंच.

latn.hi: Call, log, next. Bas, itna hi.
latn.mr: Call, log, next. Bas, evdhach.
